# BrakeSense

> Forward-collision warning for iPhone. BrakeSense is a driver aid: the phone's rear camera watches the car ahead, and the app says "Brake" out loud when the gap starts closing too fast. Collision warnings are free; Premium is optional and adds Go alerts and the full trip history.

## Key facts
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later. Android is planned.
- Status: coming soon to the App Store.
- Made by Harrison and Nick. It started as their team's project at Hacklanta 2026.
- Free: collision warnings with a spoken alert, directions on the camera view, trip recaps for the last 7 days, saved clips, crash check-in with emergency contacts.
- Premium (optional; monthly, yearly with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time Lifetime purchase): Go alerts (traffic start and green light), the full trip history with weekly trends, and a compact turn banner.
- Privacy: car detection runs on the phone, video stays on the phone, and the app has no ads or trackers. Only emergency contacts use a server: contact names and numbers, the location sent during a crash check-in, and a short summary after each trip.
- Limits: BrakeSense warns; it doesn't brake or steer. It can miss cars in glare, rain, fog or darkness. It has not been independently tested.
